title: Sonny Sends His Own Draft Pick Packing as Jeanty and Watson Join The Horse is Hea
dek: Sonny gets 217.5 points of production for 143 in a two-for-two with Kai, and he gets them right before the biggest game of week 8.
body: Before week 8, Sonny's The Horse is Hea and Mekhi's Dawgs agreed to a two-for-two. Wide receiver Christian Watson and running back Ashton Jeanty go to the Horse. Running back James Cook III and wide receiver Jameson Williams head to the Dawgs. The structure is the same RB-and-WR for RB-and-WR swap we saw in Sonny's deal with Philly, but this time the numbers tilt the other way.

Start with what Sonny is getting. Watson has 112.5 points in seven weeks on a roster, about 16.1 per week and the best rate of anyone in this deal. Jeanty adds 105, an even 15 per week, which means the Horse just traded for 217.5 points of production. Jeanty has also moved around plenty this season: JMoney drafted him, he went to Kai in an earlier trade, and now he lands in his third home before Halloween.

Kai's side is built around Cook, a 108.6-point back averaging about 15.5 per week, nearly identical to Jeanty. Cook is also the player Sonny drafted ninth overall, so the Horse is moving one of its first two picks for the same kind of production at the same position. The gap is at receiver. Jameson Williams has 34.4 points in four weeks rostered, about 8.6 per week, and while 23.6 of those came in his huge week 7, that's still a sizable step down from Watson. Add it up and the Dawgs receive 143 points to the Horse's 217.5, a 74.5-point difference in Sonny's favor.

The title odds before the trade tell you why each side said yes. The Horse came in at 25%, a real contender trying to stack chips, while the Dawgs sat at 5%, a 2-5 team that needs something to change. Post-trade odds weren't available, so the model hasn't signed off yet, but on the raw production this is a win for Sonny on paper and not a close one. Kai's best case is that he knows something about Williams the season totals don't show yet, and if anyone in this league would spot that, it's the guy who might know more football than all of us.

Both new rosters get tested right away. The Horse visits Team Pillbert in week 8 with second place on the line, and Sonny now goes into the Philly rematch with Watson and Jeanty in place of the back he drafted at nine. The Dawgs host Ramon's No Banner only HULK, which is a tough place to debut a new backfield. If Cook goes off against the first-place team, Kai gets the last laugh. If not, Sonny will be the one leaving the trade window with the bigger cart.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Trade: The Horse is Hea acquires Christian Watson (112.5 pts) and Ashton Jeanty (105) from Dawgs for James Cook III (108.6) and Jameson Williams (34.4). Pre-trade title odds: The Horse is Hea 25%, Dawgs 5%.

social.author: Dawgs
social.text: Welcome to the kennel, James Cook III and Jameson Williams! 🐾 First assignment: the HULK in week 8. No easing in.

social.author: Trade Calculator Tina
social.text: 217.5 points in, 143 out. Sonny turned his ninth overall pick into Jeanty and got Watson thrown in for a guy averaging 8.6. Math says Horse, and it isn't close.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dre
social.text: Jeanty's been on three teams this year and I liked him on ours. But we're 2-5 and Kai knows ball. Trust the process. Cook, eat. 🐾

social.author: Horse Trader Hank
social.text: Two months ago Sonny drafted Cook at 9. Now he flips him right before the Philly rematch. Bold. Watson averaging 16 a week makes it a lot less bold. 🐎
